Privacy Policy

VAgeWell Care · Last updated: 29 October 2026

Your health information is personal. This Privacy Policy explains what data VAgeWell ("we", "us", "our") collects through the VAgeWell Care mobile app and website (the "App"), why we collect it, who we share it with, and your rights. We are the Data Fiduciary for your personal data under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ("DPDP Act").

1. Data we collect

  • Account and contact: your name and mobile number. If you sign in with Google, we also receive your Google name and email address. We do not use passwords; you sign in with a one-time password (OTP).
  • Profile: date of birth or age, gender, address, height, weight, preferred language, and an optional profile photo.
  • Family members: name, relationship, age or date of birth, gender, and phone number of family members you add.
  • Bookings: the service, dates, time, the person receiving care, and any symptoms or notes you share with us.
  • Body measurements and BMI: weight, height, waist, hip, BMI history, and other body measurements you enter.
  • Nutrition: meal photos you take for Meal Scanner, and the AI-estimated foods, calories, and nutrients.
  • Lab reports: reports you upload for Lab Report Insights, and the AI explanation of the values.
  • Self-assessments: your answers to health questionnaires, and the resulting scores.
  • Health records from visits: vitals and notes our care staff record during a visit, such as sugar level and blood group, and reports they upload for you.
  • Visit and payment records: visit photos taken by our care staff, which are tagged with the location where they were taken, and payment screenshots.
  • Feedback: ratings and comments you send us.
  • Technical data: basic device and app information, IP address, and error logs, which our hosting providers record automatically to keep the App working and secure.

The App does not track your location. Location access is asked for only on our care staff's phones, to tag the visit photo they take at your home. The camera and photo library are used only when you choose to take or upload a photo or report. We do not access your contacts, and we do not collect card or bank details in the App.

2. Why we use your data

  • To create and manage your account and your family members' details.
  • To arrange and deliver the home care visits you book, and to contact you about them.
  • To provide each feature, for example estimating nutrients from a meal photo or explaining the values in a lab report.
  • To show your health records, progress, and trends to you and to the care staff looking after you.
  • To keep the App secure, prevent misuse, and fix problems.
  • To improve the App and our services, using de-identified or aggregated data where possible.
  • To comply with legal obligations.

We do not sell your personal data. We do not use your health data for advertising, or to make decisions about your employment, insurance, or credit.

3. Consent

We process your personal data based on the consent you give when you sign up and when you choose to use a feature, such as Meal Scanner or Lab Report Insights.

  • You can withdraw consent at any time by deleting your account (Profile tab → Delete my account), or by writing to info@vagewell.com. Withdrawing consent is as easy as giving it.
  • If you withdraw consent, we will stop processing the related data and delete it, unless the law requires us to keep it. Some features may stop working.
  • Withdrawal does not affect processing that happened before it.
  • We may process limited data without consent only where the DPDP Act allows, such as to comply with the law or to respond to a medical emergency.

4. Children and family members

You must be 18 or older to create an account. A parent or legal guardian may add a child as a family member and book care for them. By doing so, the parent or guardian gives consent for us to process the child's data for that purpose. We do not use children's data for tracking, behavioural monitoring, or advertising.

If you add an adult family member, you confirm that they have agreed to you sharing their details with us.

5. AI processing

Meal Scanner and Lab Report Insights send your photo or document to Anthropic, our AI service provider (Claude), to produce estimates. Anthropic processes this data only to give us the result, under its commercial terms, which do not allow it to train its models on this data. AI results are estimates and are never used to make legal, employment, or insurance decisions about you.

6. Who we share data with

  • Our care team: the care staff assigned to your visit, and our administrators, see the details they need to arrange and deliver your care, such as your name, phone number, address, booking details, health records, and reports. Visit details may be sent to the assigned staff member over WhatsApp.
  • Service providers (Data Processors): Supabase (database, file storage, and sign-in), our SMS provider (to send OTPs), Anthropic (AI processing), Vercel (website hosting), and Google (only if you choose to sign in with Google). They receive only the data they need for their task.
  • Healthcare professionals or labs you choose to work with: only the data you ask us to share with them.
  • Authorities: data the law requires us to share, for example under a court order, or to protect someone's safety.

Every processor is bound by terms that require confidentiality and security.

7. Where and how we store data

  • Your data is stored securely with our cloud provider, Supabase. Some of our providers, such as Anthropic, may process data outside India. We transfer data outside India only as the DPDP Act allows.
  • We use encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest, and access controls so that each person sees only the data they are allowed to see.
  • No system is completely secure. If a personal data breach happens, we will notify you and the Data Protection Board of India as the law requires.

8. How long we keep data

  • We keep your data while your account is active.
  • When you delete your account, we delete your account, profile, family members, bookings, and the photos, payment screenshots, and reports stored with them. Results saved on your phone are removed from that phone. Remaining copies, such as backups, are deleted within 30 days, unless the law requires us to keep them longer.
  • We may keep anonymised, aggregated data that cannot identify you.

9. Your rights

Under the DPDP Act, you have the right to:

  1. Access: get a summary of your personal data and how we process it.
  2. Correction and update: correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
  3. Erasure: ask us to delete your data.
  4. Withdraw consent at any time.
  5. Grievance redressal: complain to our Grievance Officer, and then to the Data Protection Board of India.
  6. Nominate a person to exercise your rights if you die or become unable to act.

You can view and edit your details, and delete your account, from the Profile tab. For anything else, write to info@vagewell.com. We will respond within 30 days.

10. Cookies and analytics

The website version of the App stores a sign-in token in your browser to keep you signed in. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.

11. Changes to this policy

We will tell you in the App or by SMS before important changes take effect, and ask for fresh consent where the law requires.

12. Contact and Grievance Officer

Grievance Officer: Mr. Selva, VAgeWell. Email: info@vagewell.com. Phone: +91 93427 03376.

We will acknowledge your request within 24 hours and resolve it within 30 days. If you are not satisfied, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
